baseline_prompt_en: Create a photorealistic cinematic editorial photograph in a flooded underground seed-vault corridor. She drives a compact steel hydraulic ram straight into a resisting frost-white laminated resin bulkhead. Her face and upper body remain clearly visible beside the action. The surrounding wall stays finite and mostly intact while fresh radial cracks, torn layers, and bent edges spread from the single contact point. A newly opened jagged aperture is visible; the ram, her leading shoulder, and one knee coherently cross through it. Translucent shards, strips, and condensation spray remain concentrated along the contact-to-passage path. Frame the decisive midpoint in a low three-quarter portrait, with cool emergency light behind the breach and warm work light on her face, crisp material detail, believable momentum, and documentary realism.
